verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's incident response docs say you can create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to the people on call, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review. A community user also confirms that Grafana Cloud includes incident management. However, incident timelines are never documented, and escalation is described only as escalating alerts rather than as configurable escalation policies. missing for 10: explicit incident timeline tracking, documented configurable escalation policies, in-depth first-party docs and hands-on corroboration of on-call and escalation behavior.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies

citations.quote: Use it to create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to the people who are on call, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review.
During an incident, you can investigate with the same metrics, logs, and traces that fired the alert.
you get decent metrics, logs, alerts, tracing and incident management at an excellent price
